detected_issues.issue: after_commit does not check for existence or type of session._changes
detected_issues.root_cause: Missing defensive programming checks before accessing session._changes
detected_issues.fix_description: Added comprehensive defensive checks: verify session.info exists and is dict, check _changes exists, validate class-specific changes structure, and type-check before processing

detected_issues.root_cause: No cleanup mechanism after commit, leaving stale data that could be processed multiple times
detected_issues.fix_description: Clear/reset _changes at start of each transaction in before_commit, and explicitly delete class-specific changes after processing in after_commit (in finally block)

detected_issues.issue: _changes attached directly to global db.session (not thread-safe)
detected_issues.root_cause: Direct attribute assignment to shared session object causes race conditions in concurrent requests
detected_issues.fix_description: Use session.info dictionary instead of direct session attributes. session.info is designed to be thread-safe and session-scoped

detected_issues.root_cause: No synchronization mechanism around index updates, causing race conditions
detected_issues.fix_description: Implemented threading.Lock (_index_lock) around all index update operations in add_to_index() function

detected_issues.issue: Incomplete test coverage for edge cases
detected_issues.root_cause: Tests did not simulate missing/leftover _changes scenarios
detected_issues.fix_description: Added comprehensive test coverage: missing _changes, leftover _changes cleanup, rollback scenarios, concurrent commits, type safety, transaction isolation, exception handling

detected_issues.root_cause: Used db.event.listen(db.session, ...) which binds to specific session instance rather than Session class
detected_issues.fix_description: Adopted SQLAlchemy recommended event.listens_for(Session, ...) pattern with __init_subclass__ registry to automatically track all SearchableMixin subclasses

models.py: Added defensive checks for _changes existence and type in before_commit and after_commit
Implemented session.info for thread-safe, session-scoped storage
Added cleanup of _changes after commit in finally block
Implemented atomic index updates with threading.Lock
Changed to event.listens_for(Session, ...) pattern for proper event binding
Added __init_subclass__ registry pattern to track SearchableMixin subclasses
test_concurrency.py: Added comprehensive test coverage (12 tests total)
Fixed app context handling for concurrent tests
Added type safety tests for malformed _changes
Added concurrent commit tests (creates, updates, deletes)
